papers.title: Recent Advances in Causal Analysis of the Stochastic Frontier Model
papers.abstract: Causal inference methods (instrumental variables, difference-in-differences, regression discontinuity, etc.) are primary tools used across many social science milieus. One area where their application has lagged however, is in the study of productivity and efficiency. A main reason for this is that the nature of the stochastic frontier model does not immediately lend itself to a causal framework when interest hinges on an error component of the model. This paper reviews the nascent literature on attempts to merge the stochastic frontier literature with causal inference methods. We discuss modeling approaches and empirical issues that are likely to be relevant for applied researchers in this area. This review shows how this model can be easily put within the confines of causal analysis, reviews existing work that has already made inroads in this area, addresses challenges that have yet to be met and discusses core findings.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】因果推断方法（如工具变量法、差分法、回归不连续性分析法等）是许多社会科学领域中常用的主要工具。然而，在生产力和效率研究领域，这些方法的应用相对滞后。其中一个主要原因是随机前沿模型的本质并不适合直接用于因果分析框架，尤其是在模型中存在误差成分的情况下。本文回顾了将随机前沿模型与因果推断方法相结合的相关研究文献，探讨了该领域应用研究者可能感兴趣的建模方法和实证问题。文章指出如何将随机前沿模型纳入因果分析的框架，总结了已有研究在该领域取得的进展，分析了尚未解决的挑战，并总结了核心研究发现。。研究方法：回归分析、双重差分、工具变量、因果推断、断点回归、随机过程。

papers.title: Comment on "The Forsaken Road: Reassessing Living Standards Following the Cuban Revolution and the American Embargo"
papers.abstract: Bastos, Geloso, and Bologna Pavlik (2026) argue that the US embargo explains less than one tenth of the difference in per capita income between Cuba and a counterfactual scenario in which the country did not follow socialist economic policies. We show that their results are driven by the use of an elasticity of income to trade openness that is neither representative nor a reasonable upper bound of the values found in the literature and by their choice to attribute the effect of the interaction between the embargo and other determinants of growth solely to those other determinants. We show that, once these problems are corrected, the embargo can account for a substantial fraction, and in some cases all, of Cuba's post 1959 economic underperformance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】Bastos、Geloso和Bologna Pavlik（2026）认为，美国对古巴的制裁只能解释古巴人均收入与一种假设性情景（即古巴未采取社会主义经济政策）之间收入差异的不到十分之一。我们指出，他们的研究结果受到以下两个因素的影响：一是他们所使用的收入对贸易开放度的弹性系数既不具有代表性，也不是文献中发现的弹性系数的合理上限；二是他们将制裁与其他经济增长决定因素之间的相互作用效应完全归因于这些其他决定因素。我们进一步证明，一旦纠正了这些问题，制裁就可以解释古巴1959年后经济表现不佳的很大一部分原因，在某些情况下甚至可以解释全部原因。。

papers.title: Fertility in Honduras
papers.venue: International Journal of Economics and Finance
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the determinants of fertility in Honduras, using data from the period 1991-2022. Equations are estimated to identify the role of variables from the real, monetary, and labor sectors on fertility. The results show that fertility is mainly determined by female unemployment rates, salaried employment rates, and self-employment rates, with investment and exports also playing a role. A result of particular interest is the role of the economic dynamism of other Central American countries on Honduran fertility, which highlights the existence of a regional fertility “network”.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文利用1991至2022年的数据，研究了洪都拉斯生育率的决定因素。通过建立方程模型，分析了实体经济、货币市场和劳动力市场各变量对生育率的影响。研究结果表明，生育率主要受女性失业率、有薪就业率以及自雇率的影响，同时投资和出口也起到一定作用。一个值得关注的现象是其他中美洲国家的经济活力对洪都拉斯生育率的影响，这表明该地区存在一种生育率的“联动机制”。。

papers.title: Non Performing Loans and Bank Performance in Vietnam: The Moderating Role of Professional Ethics
papers.venue: Journal of economics, finance and management studies
papers.abstract: This study investigates non-performing loans' impact on listed Vietnamese commercial banks' performance (2015–2024), testing professional ethics' moderating role through panel data analysis. Results confirm NPLs significantly erode profitability, while ethics Index, comprising ESG disclosure, Big4 audits, and governance practices, independently enhances banks’ performance. Notably, professional ethics amplifies NPL sensitivity. Ethical banks experience substantially greater profitability declines from credit deterioration than low-ethics peers, revealing transparency's double-edged nature during credit shocks. Scale, lending intensity, and capital adequacy positively contribute to performance. Vietnam's post-restructuring, Basel III context underscores credit risk governance amid real estate distress. Findings challenge conventional ethics-as-risk-buffer assumptions, highlighting ethics' dual role as performance enhancer yet vulnerability amplifier. The study suggests policy recommendations advocating stricter credit appraisal, dynamic liquidity management, and ethics-integrated risk frameworks.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本研究探讨了不良贷款对越南上市商业银行绩效（2015–2024年）的影响，并通过面板数据分析检验了职业道德在其中的调节作用。研究结果证实，不良贷款显著侵蚀了银行的盈利能力；而职业道德指数（包括环境、社会和治理（ESG）信息披露、四大审计机构审计以及公司治理实践）则能够独立提升银行的绩效。值得注意的是，职业道德会加剧不良贷款对银行绩效的负面影响。具有较高职业道德水平的银行在信贷质量恶化时，其盈利能力下降幅度明显大于职业道德水平较低的银行，这揭示了透明度在信贷危机中的双重作用。银行规模、贷款规模以及资本充足率对银行绩效具有积极影响。越南在重组后实施的巴塞尔III框架要求在房地产行业困境中加强信用风险管理。研究结果挑战了“职业道德能作为风险缓冲”的传统观点，强调了职业道德在提升绩效的同时也可能放大风险的作用。研究提出了相关政策建议，包括加强信贷评估、实施动态流动性管理以及建立融入职业道德要素的风险管理体系。。研究方法：面板数据。

papers.title: The Impact of Maternal Education on Early Childhood Development -- by Moriam Khanam, Mohammad Hajizadeh, Casey Warman
papers.abstract: This study leverages exogenous variation from a secondary school stipend program for female students in rural Bangladesh to estimate the causal effect of maternal education on early childhood development. Using data from the 2019 Bangladesh Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey, we find that the five years of stipend eligibility increase mothers' schooling by about one year. Instrumental variable estimates show that an additional year of maternal education improves early childhood development scores by 0.5 points on a scale of 0-10, with gains in overall developmental readiness (7.5 percentage points) and in the literacy–numeracy (7.7  percentage points) and physical (1.9 percentage points) domains. The results are robust across specifications. We also estimate the effects of maternal education on potential mechanisms, including children's nutrition, home learning environment, parenting practices, and use of early childhood education and care. The findings show that improvements in maternal education increase weight-for-age Z-scores, reduce stunting, improve the probability of having toys from shops, and increase the likelihood of an adult household member playing with the child. The positive effects of maternal education on children's developmental outcomes imply the importance of investment in improving educational attainment, particularly for females in low- and middle-income countries.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究利用孟加拉国农村地区针对女学生的中学助学金计划所带来的外生性变化，来估计母亲教育水平对儿童早期发展的影响。通过分析2019年孟加拉国多项指标集群调查的数据，我们发现获得助学金的五年期间，母亲的受教育年限平均增加了约一年。工具变量估计结果显示，母亲受教育年限每增加一年，儿童在0-10分制的早期发展评估得分会上升0.5分，其中整体发展准备程度提高7.5个百分点，读写能力（7.7个百分点）和身体发展（1.9个百分点）也有所改善。这些结果在不同模型设定下均具有稳定性。我们还探讨了母亲教育对其他相关因素的影响，包括儿童的营养状况、家庭学习环境、育儿方式以及儿童是否能够接受早期教育和保育服务。研究发现，母亲教育水平的提高有助于提升儿童的体重与年龄比Z分数，减少发育迟缓现象，增加儿童从商店购买玩具的可能性，并提高家庭成员与儿童互动的频率。母亲教育对儿童发展结果的积极影响表明，投资于提高教育水平尤为重要，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。。研究方法：调查数据、工具变量。

papers.title: Tariffs and the Term Structure of Inflation Expectations -- by Stéphane Auray, Michael B. Devereux, Anthony M. Diercks, Aurélien Eyquem, Joon Kim
papers.abstract:
Inflation expectations derived from financial markets exhibited unprecedented dynamics in 2025: the correlation between one-year inflation swaps and one-year-ahead one-year forward rates turned significantly negative for the first time on record. We show that this decoupling occurred primarily on days when tariff news dominated market pricing, using a two-stage event classification validated by Bloomberg news trends. Standard small open-economy New Keynesian models in which tariffs generate a one-time price-level increase imply positive comovement across horizons and cannot explain this pattern. 
We explain these occurrences through the lens of an amended small open-economy New Keynesian model. Three ingredients prove critical for reproducing the observed negative conditional correlation between spot and forward inflation after tariff shocks: targeting year-on-year inflation, substantial interest-rate inertia, and persistent tariffs. Under empirically plausible calibrations, the model generates a negative correlation conditional on tariff shocks while preserving a positive unconditional correlation, suggesting that the 2025 twist in the term structure reflects expectations of a persistent policy response to trade shocks.
papers.summary_zh:
【货币政策与宏观经济】2025年，来自金融市场的通胀预期表现出前所未有的动态变化：一年期通胀互换合约与一年期远期利率之间的相关性首次出现显著负值。我们通过使用由彭博新闻趋势验证的两阶段事件分类方法发现，这种脱钩现象主要发生在关税新闻主导市场定价的时期。传统的、适用于小型开放经济体的新凯恩斯主义模型认为关税会导致一次性的价格水平上升，这些模型预测不同时间段的通胀率应呈现正相关，但无法解释这一现象。

我们通过修订后的小型开放经济体新凯恩斯主义模型来解释这些现象。在该模型中，有三个关键因素对于再现关税冲击后现货通胀与远期通胀之间的负相关关系至关重要：一是将通胀目标设定为同比通胀率；二是利率具有显著的惯性；三是关税政策会持续实施。在符合实证合理性的参数设定下，该模型能够模拟出在关税冲击条件下通胀率的负相关关系，同时仍保持通胀率之间的正无条件相关性。这表明2025年通胀期限结构的变化反映了市场对贸易冲击将引发持续政策反应的预期。。

papers.title: Tuning in to Frequencies: How Global Assets Align U.S. Put-Call Parity Residuals
papers.abstract: Put-call parity holds under risk-neutral pricing, yet enforcement exposes arbitrageurs to path-dependent capital costs. The carry gap-the annualized wedge between option-implied and OIS discount factors-is a Q-measure object, but P-measure investment opportunities may shape its enforcement burden. We document this alignment in SPX and RUT options: low-frequency global asset returns raise in-sample R^2 by 0.093 and 0.082 and lift pooled out-of-sample R^2 from 0.221 to 0.364 (SPX) and 0.171 to 0.309 (RUT). Effective horizons differ by asset-IEFA (70 days), IGOV (400 days), IAU (336 days)-and asset terms largely absorb the OIS baseline, providing systematic evidence of a P-Q channel.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在风险中性定价假设下，看涨-看跌平价关系成立；然而，这一关系的实际执行过程会使得套利者面临与资产价格路径相关的资本成本。所谓的“carry gap”（即期权隐含折现因子与OIS折现因子之间的年化差异）属于Q-测度对象，但P-测度性质的投资机会可能会影响这一平价关系的实际执行效果。我们在SPX和RUT期权中观察到了这种关联性：低频全球资产回报的变动使得样本内的R²值分别提高了0.093和0.082，同时将样本外的R²值从0.221提升至0.364（SPX）以及从0.171提升至0.309（RUT）。不同资产的有效期限（IEFA为70天、IGOV为400天、IAU为336天）对结果产生了影响，且资产本身的特性在很大程度上掩盖了OIS基准的影响，从而为P-测度与Q-测度之间的关联提供了系统性证据。。

papers.title: The Cost of a Free Lunch: Evidence from U.S. Derivatives Markets
papers.abstract: Put-call parity is a terminal-payoff identity; quoted residuals against traded futures are near zero. Yet enforcing parity is path-dependent, exposing arbitrageurs to daily settlement, margin, and finite capital. Using minute-level NBBO data on S&P 500 and Russell 2000 options, I extract option-implied discount factors, compare them with the OIS curve, and construct an annualized carry gap. A reduced-form specification centered on a volatility times sqrt(tau) path-risk term links the carry gap to implementation risk, trading frictions, and financial conditions, with coefficient signs stable across leave-one-year-out validation. The carry gap is an implementation wedge invisible in price space but systematic in carry space.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】平价关系（Put-call parity）是一种与期权最终收益相关的性质；相对于交易中的期货合约，期权价格与其理论价值之间的残差几乎为零。然而，实现这种平价关系实际上依赖于具体的交易路径，这使套利者面临每日结算、保证金要求以及资本限制等风险。通过使用标普500指数和罗素2000指数期权的分钟级报价数据（NBBO数据），我提取了期权隐含的贴现因子，并将其与无风险利率（OIS）曲线进行比较，进而计算出了年化的“携带缺口”（carry gap）。一个以波动率与时间平方根（tau）的乘积为基础的简化模型将“携带缺口”与实施风险、交易摩擦以及金融市场状况联系起来；该模型中的系数符号在经过一年数据剔除后的验证过程中保持稳定。这种“携带缺口”在价格维度上并不明显，但在实际的资金流动（携带）维度上却具有系统性特征。。

papers.title: Probabilistic Forecasting for Day-ahead Electricity Prices, Battery Trading Strategies and the Economic Evaluation of Predictive Accuracy
papers.abstract: Electricity price forecasting supports decision-making in energy markets and asset operation. Probabilistic forecasts are increasingly adopted to explicitly quantify uncertainty, typically issued as quantile predictions or ensembles of the full predictive distribution. However, how improvements in statistical forecast quality translate into economic value remains unclear. Battery storage arbitrage in day-ahead markets is a popular application-based benchmark for this purpose. We analyze quantile-based trading strategies (QBTS) and identify two critical flaws: they do not incentivize honest probabilistic forecasting and they ignore the intertemporal dependence structure of electricity prices. We therefore frame battery optimization as a stochastic program based on fully probabilistic forecasts and examine decision quality measurement for risk-neutral and risk-averse settings under different uncertainty models. Our discussion touches both sides of the coin: How reliable is the economic evaluation of forecasting models though (simplified) application studies - and how do improvements in statistical forecast quality for stochastic programs relate to the decision-quality and economic performance? We provide theoretical justification and empirical evidence from a case study on the German electricity market. Our results highlight the pitfalls of ranking forecasting models through battery trading strategies. We conclude with implications for evaluation practice and directions for future research in application-based forecast assessment.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】电价预测为能源市场的决策和资产运营提供了支持。概率预测方法被越来越多地采用，以明确量化不确定性，通常以分位数预测或完整预测分布的集合形式呈现。然而，统计预测质量的提升如何转化为经济价值仍不明确。日前市场中的电池储能套利是用于此目的的一个常见应用基准。我们分析了基于分位数的交易策略（QBTS），并发现了两个关键缺陷：这些策略无法激励人们进行诚实的概率预测，同时忽略了电价的时间依赖性结构。因此，我们将电池储能优化问题构建为一个基于完全概率预测的随机规划模型，并在不同不确定性模型下，考察了风险中性和风险厌恶情境下的决策质量评估。我们的讨论涵盖了两个方面的问题：通过（简化的）应用研究对预测模型进行经济评估的可靠性如何；以及统计预测质量的提升如何影响随机规划的决策质量和经济表现？我们提供了理论依据，并通过德国电力市场的案例研究提供了实证证据。我们的研究结果指出了通过电池储能交易策略对预测模型进行排序的潜在问题。最后，我们提出了对评估实践的启示以及未来基于应用场景的预测评估研究的方向。。研究方法：随机过程、优化方法。

papers.title: Cross-Stock Predictability via LLM-Augmented Semantic Networks
papers.abstract: Text-based financial networks are increasingly used to study cross-stock return predictability. A common approach constructs links from similarities in firms' disclosure embeddings, but such networks often contain spurious edges because textual proximity does not necessarily imply economic connection. We propose a two-stage framework that first builds a sparse candidate graph from 10-K embeddings and then uses a large language model to classify and filter candidate edges according to their economic relations. The refined graph is used to aggregate pair-level mean-reversion signals into stock-level trading signals with relation-aware and distance-based weights. In a backtest on S&P 500 constituents from 2011 to 2019, LLM-based edge filtering improves the long-short Sharpe ratio from 0.742 to 0.820 and reduces maximum drawdown from $-$10.47% to $-$7.85%. These results suggest that LLM-based reasoning can improve the economic fidelity of text-derived financial networks and strengthen cross-stock predictability.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】基于文本的金融网络被越来越多地用于研究股票间回报的可预测性。一种常见的方法是通过分析企业在财务报告中披露的信息（即“披露嵌入”）之间的相似性来构建网络连接，但这些网络中往往包含许多无实际经济意义的虚假边（即“虚假边”），因为文本上的接近性并不一定意味着实际的经济关联。我们提出了一种两阶段框架：首先利用10-K年报中的披露嵌入数据构建一个稀疏的候选图；随后使用大型语言模型对这些候选边进行分类和筛选，以判断它们是否具有实际的经济意义。经过筛选后的图谱能够将股票对层面的均值回归信号整合为股票层面的交易信号，并赋予这些信号与经济关系和距离相关的权重。在对标普500指数成分股2011年至2019年的回测中，基于大型语言模型的边筛选方法将长期投资的夏普比率从0.742提升至0.820，同时将最大回撤幅度从-10.47%降低至-7.85%。这些结果表明，基于大型语言模型的推理机制能够提高文本衍生金融网络的经济真实性，从而增强股票间回报的可预测性。。

papers.title: How damaging is zero-sum thinking to an agent's interests when the world is positive-sum?
papers.abstract: We study whether zero-sum decision rules, maximin and minimax, harm agents' interests in positive-sum strategic environments relative to Nash equilibrium behavior or, more generally, than best response behaviour. Contrary to an influential evolutionary view, we give illustrations where maximin serves an agent's interests better than Nash equilibrium behaviour. We also show that these illustration are not atypical or idiosyncratic because, in our main result, the class of such games where a maximin profile strictly Pareto dominates all Nash equilibria has the same cardinality as the class of games in which a Nash equilibrium strictly Pareto dominates all maximin profiles. Thus, neither behavior is generally superior. We further identify additional mechanisms favoring maximin over Nash equilibrium, including coordination failures under multiple equilibria, where maximin can outperform Nash play in realised-pay-off terms. A systematic analysis of strictly ordinal symmetric 3x3 games shows that these effects arise with non-trivial frequency. Our findings, therefore, suggest that the observed rise in zero-sum thinking in many rich countries, when associated with a maximin decision rule, will not be readily displaced through its generation of inferior pay-offs.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了在正和策略环境中，零和决策规则（如极小极大策略和极大极小策略）是否会对代理人的利益产生损害，这种损害是相对于纳什均衡行为而言的，或者更一般地说，是相对于最佳响应行为而言的。与一种具有影响力的进化论观点相反，我们通过实例表明，在某些情况下，极大极小策略反而比纳什均衡行为更能符合代理人的利益。我们还发现，这些实例并非特例或个别现象，因为在我们的主要研究结果中，那些极大极小策略严格占据帕累托优势的游戏类别，其数量与那些纳什均衡严格占据帕累托优势的游戏类别是相同的。因此，这两种策略并没有一种在一般情况下更优。此外，我们还发现了其他有利于极大极小策略胜过纳什均衡的机制，包括在存在多个均衡的情况下协调失败时，极大极小策略在实际收益方面可能优于纳什均衡策略。对严格序对称的3x3游戏进行的系统分析表明，这些现象出现的频率相当高。因此，我们的研究结果表明，在许多富裕国家中观察到的零和思维方式的增加（如果与极大极小决策规则相关联），并不会因为这种策略导致的较低收益而轻易消失。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Global Corporate Landscape 2025: A Comparative Analysis of Asia, North America, and Europe, and Strategic Outlook for 2028–2030
papers.abstract: As the global economy navigates the mid-point of the 2020s, the corporate landscape is undergoing a profound structural transformation characterized by shifting geopolitical alliances, the rapid operationalization of artificial intelligence, and the urgent mandate for decarbonization. This paper provides a comprehensive comparative analysis of the corporate status across three major economic blocs—North America, Europe, and Asia—as of 2025. North America continues to leverage its dominance in technological innovation, particularly in generative artificial intelligence and software ecosystems, while simultaneously engaging in a massive state-subsidized reindustrialization effort. Europe has solidified its position as the global regulatory vanguard, driving corporate strategies toward sustainability, circular economies, and stringent technological governance. Meanwhile, Asia is characterized by a rapid restructuring of global supply chains, technological leapfrogging in clean energy manufacturing, and the maturation of the "China Plus One" strategy. Furthermore, this study projects future development and market opportunities over the next three to five years (2028–2030), emphasizing the commercialization of next-generation energy systems, the transition from artificial intelligence integration to artificial general intelligence (AGI) readiness, and the establishment of hyper-resilient supply networks. By synthesizing macroeconomic data, corporate strategy shifts, and regulatory frameworks, this paper aims to provide strategic foresight for multinational enterprises navigating an increasingly fragmented yet interdependent global economy.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】随着全球经济进入2020年代的中期，企业格局正在经历一场深刻的结构性变革，其特点包括地缘政治联盟的重新调整、人工智能技术的快速应用以及脱碳目标的迫切要求。本文对2025年三大主要经济区域——北美、欧洲和亚洲的企业状况进行了全面的比较分析。北美继续凭借其在技术创新方面的优势（尤其是在生成式人工智能和软件生态系统领域），同时开展大规模的政府补贴下的再工业化进程。欧洲巩固了其作为全球监管先锋的地位，推动企业战略向可持续性、循环经济和严格的技术治理方向发展。亚洲则表现为全球供应链的快速重组、清洁能源制造业的技术飞跃，以及“中国+1”战略的成熟。此外，本研究还预测了未来三到五年（2028-2030年）的发展趋势和市场机遇，重点关注下一代能源系统的商业化、从人工智能集成向通用人工智能（AGI）发展的转变，以及超韧性供应链的构建。通过综合宏观经济数据、企业战略调整和监管框架，本文旨在为跨国企业提供战略洞察，帮助它们在日益碎片化却又相互依存的全球经济中找到发展方向。。
